headline: Resolution would have blocked a proposed US sale of certain weapons and military services to Israel; the Senate declined to advance it.
what_it_does: This joint resolution would have let Congress formally reject a specific proposed foreign military sale to the Government of Israel. If passed by both chambers and signed into law, or if a veto were overridden, the sale would have been blocked. The title does not say which weapons or services were in the sale, and no official summary is available. On November 20, 2024, the Senate voted not to move forward with it.

who_it_affects.how: Israel would not have received the specific defense items and services covered by this proposed sale.
Companies supplying the items in this sale would not have completed those sales to Israel.
The executive branch would have been barred from going ahead with this particular sale.
